pass_rule: judge net > base AND judge PF > base AND judge trades >= 60 AND beats its random control (pre-specified per idea); an idea with no pick-window pick is REJECT without a judge verdict.

variants.E30a: entry checks every 30 min 10:00..15:30 (k=29..359), exits stay hourly
variants.E30b: entry checks every 30 min 10:00..15:00 (k=29..329), exits stay hourly

1_entry_cadence.pick_rule: pick PF >= base AND pick net >= base; highest pick net among those
1_entry_cadence.control: (a) judge PF and net above the 95th pct of the random-direction version of the pick (500 seeds); (b) judge delta vs base above the 95th pct of random-direction deltas (same seeds)

variants.VT: Pro 50K frame (base = fixed 2 micros @ $250): q = clip(round(2 x target / vol14), 1, 3); vol14 = std of the prior 14 RTH close-to-close returns; target = pick-window median vol14

2_vol_target_sizing.pick_rule: pick net >= base AND pick Sharpe > base
2_vol_target_sizing.extra_judge_rule: judge Sharpe > base AND judge max DD <= base
2_vol_target_sizing.control: judge delta net above the 95th pct of 2000 random permutations of the same size vector

variants.G1: trade only if sig10 >= pick median

3_candace_regime_gate.features: sig10 = prior-14-day mean |close(10:00)/open-1| (NOISE band at 10:00, known pre-open); or5 = 09:30-09:34 high-low / 14-day mean daily range (known at 09:35; every CANDACE entry is bar >= 5)
3_candace_regime_gate.pick_rule: pick trades >= 60, pick PF > base, pick net >= base; highest pick PF
3_candace_regime_gate.control: judge net and PF above the 95th pct of 5000 random subsets of the judge trades of the same size

variants.P1: NOISE-first: if NOISE signals while a CANDACE/late position is open, flatten it at the open of the NOISE entry bar and enter NOISE one bar later (D139 wait-for-flat)

4_leg_priority.baseline: shipped first-come, one position per account; same-bar tie -> NOISE (dispatch order)
4_leg_priority.primary: NOISE + CANDACE (1 micro each); secondary: + late-day leg
4_leg_priority.pick_rule: pick combined net >= base AND pick PF >= base
4_leg_priority.control: judge delta above the 95th pct of P1-vs-P0 deltas with a random-direction NOISE stream (500 seeds)

ideas.5_github_ports: not run (no repo fetch; the two paper differences it would surface, 30-min checks and vol sizing, are ideas 1-2)
